data.name: Whisker & The Lost Sun
data.detailed_description:
Whisker & The Lost Sun is a cozy storybook adventure about a brave little courier cat, his loyal dog companion, and a golden world slowly fading into shadow.

When the Great Sun shatters above the land of Ambervale, warmth, color, and music begin to disappear. Play as Whisker, a small but determined cat with a red cap, a trusty satchel, and a big heart, as he sets out to recover the missing Sun Fragments and restore light to the world.

But Whisker is not alone. By his side is Mallow, a gentle but powerful dog companion who helps him push heavy objects, dig up secrets, break obstacles, protect him from danger, and solve puzzles that one hero could never complete alone.

Explore forests, rooftops, clockwork towns, crystal mines, forgotten toy kingdoms, lantern-lit lakes, mountain trails, and moonlit dreamlands. Along the way, you will help villagers, deliver lost letters, collect Sun-Sparks, uncover hidden Moon Charms, and follow the mysterious trail left behind by Whisker’s grandfather.

What begins as a journey to restore the sun soon becomes something deeper. The darkness spreading across Ambervale may not be evil at all — only forgotten. To save the world, Whisker and Mallow must learn the truth behind the lost sun, the forgotten moon, and the balance between light and shadow.

A LITTLE CAT, A BIG ADVENTURE

Whisker may be small, but his courage carries him far beyond home. Run, jump, climb, explore, and discover secrets across a handcrafted storybook world filled with charm, mystery, and danger.

YOUR LOYAL COMPANION, MALLOW

Mallow is more than a companion — he is your partner. Use his strength, senses, and loyalty to overcome obstacles, uncover hidden paths, and protect Whisker throughout the adventure.

RESTORE AMBERVALE

Collect Sun-Sparks and recover lost Sun Fragments to bring life back to each area. As you progress, the world begins to change: flowers bloom, lanterns glow, clocks tick again, music returns, and the sky slowly remembers its color.

UNCOVER THE FORGOTTEN TRUTH

Follow clues left behind by Whisker’s grandfather and discover the story of Noctilune, the forgotten Moon-Mender. Restore the sun, remember the moon, and bring balance back to the sky.

KEY FEATURES

  • Play as Whisker, a brave courier cat on a heartfelt adventure

  • Travel with Mallow, a loyal big dog companion with unique abilities

  • Explore a cozy storybook world filled with secrets, puzzles, and collectibles

  • Run, jump, climb, solve puzzles, and help villagers across Ambervale

  • Use teamwork to overcome obstacles with Whisker’s agility and Mallow’s strength

  • Collect Sun-Sparks, Sun Fragments, Lost Letters, Moon Charms, hat pins, and cosmetics

  • Restore each area and watch the world return to life

  • Discover an emotional story about friendship, courage, memory, light, and shadow

The sun is broken. The world is fading. But hope still walks forward — on four small paws, with four big ones beside them.

data.short_description: A cozy storybook adventure platformer where you play as Whisker, a brave courier cat, and work with your loyal dog companion Mallow to explore magical worlds, solve puzzles, collect Sun Fragments, and restore light to Ambervale.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 1.8 GHz
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1200 MB available space
